items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary_en: diagram-design is a Claude Code skill that generates editorial-quality diagrams (42 types including Sankey, Wardley maps, and UML) as self-contained HTML+SVG—no Mermaid, Figma, or external dependencies. It auto-matches brand colors by scanning your website in 60 seconds and ships each type in three variants: minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial. The latest version adds ten layout grammars, semantic system patterns, and optional accessible motion while keeping static output as default.

items.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
items.summary_en: i-have-adhd is a Claude coding assistant skill that eliminates verbose AI output by enforcing 10 rules: lead with the next action, number multi-step tasks, cap lists at 5 items, provide specific time estimates, and suppress preambles, recaps, and closers. Installation is via `claude plugin marketplace add`, and the SKILL.md file can be forked and customized. The prompt is adapted from *The Adult ADHD Tool Kit* by J. Russell Ramsay and Anthony L. Rostain and is licensed under MIT.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary_en: claude-mem is a persistent context system for AI coding agents that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant session memories into future interactions. It supports Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, Grok Bot, and others via a single `npx claude-mem install` command with IDE-specific flags. The service offers a 30-day free trial with memory running off-plan, and installs are available directly from the Claude Code plugin marketplace.

items.title: Anthropic 用 Claude Managed Agents 构建定时智能体自动化的实践指南
items.summary_en: Anthropic released a reference implementation for scheduled agent automations using Claude Managed Agents (beta), which reads from Slack and GitHub sources and posts daily briefs to Slack. The build is structured around six reusable components—sources, destination, agent, schedule, memory, and guardrails—with secure credential storage in a vault (MCP for GitHub, sandboxed shell for Slack) and bookmark-based incremental reads to avoid gaps or duplicates. Error-handling rules ensure failed sources don't corrupt state: bookmarks are preserved, the brief incorporates available sources, and missing data is explicitly noted.

items.title: ttok 0.4
items.summary_en: ttok 0.4 is an update to the CLI token-counting tool built on OpenAI's tiktoken library. Key changes include fixing a Click warning, updating CI, and adding a `--list-models` command to list available models. The tool remains compatible with `uvx`, allowing users to count tokens via simple shell pipelines like `cat file.txt | uvx ttok`.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary_en: agent-skills is an open-source toolkit providing 25 production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents across 70+ platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline. It maps to the six-phase development lifecycle (Define, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, Ship) through nine slash commands, with key features like /build autonomously executing a single approved plan while maintaining test-driven verification and automatic skill activation based on context. Installation is handled via the skills CLI (`npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills`) or native plugin marketplaces.

items.title: Show HN: Streamline,recommendations from your watch history on streaming svcs
items.summary: Streamline是一款自托管（Docker + SQLite）的跨平台观影推荐工具，支持导入Netflix、Prime Video、Apple TV、Disney+、Max及Plex的GDPR数据导出，通过TMDB匹配标题并由LLM生成描述与标签构建用户品味画像。推荐时，将搜索请求转为结构化筛选条件，从TMDB Discover和LLM建议中获取候选片单，过滤已看过的内容后按用户请求优先、口味匹配次优进行排序。系统支持Claude、Gemini、OpenAI及本地模型，单次搜索成本约0.06美元。
items.summary_en: Streamline is a self-hosted (Docker, SQLite) tool that reads GDPR data exports from Netflix, Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+, Max, and Plex to build a unified watch history. It matches titles on TMDB, uses an LLM to generate descriptions and tags, then ranks recommendations against structured user requests and a taste profile derived from loved titles. The tool supports Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, or local models, with searches costing approximately 6 cents using Claude.

items.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
items.summary_en: OpenAI's release of hundreds of math problem solutions fell short of standards set by Princeton's Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence (AGMAI), with only 10 of 719 manuscripts including chain-of-thought data and just 42% undergoing formal verification in Lean. A new paper from Cambridge and King's College researchers identified discrepancies between natural language proofs and Lean code for a Navier-Stokes-derived problem, raising concerns about AI-generated solutions lacking human mathematical understanding. AGMAI criticized OpenAI for not providing machine-readable metadata correlating natural language and formal artifacts, nor committing to fund the human mathematicians needed to validate these results.

items.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
items.summary: Google 宣布推出面向企业的 Gemini Agentic AI，目前 Gemini 月活用户超 10 亿，近 90% 财富 100 强企业已在使用 Gemini Enterprise。该智能体可通过统一界面连接 Google Workspace、Microsoft 365、Slack、Jira、Git、BigQuery 等数十个系统及 MCP 服务器，支持 Anthropic Claude 等第三方模型，并拥有独立 Workspace 账户、任务收件箱和审计追踪功能，首批测试客户包括 On、Shopify 和 PayPal。
items.summary_en: Google is launching an agentic AI for Gemini that receives objectives rather than just instructions, plans tasks autonomously, and connects to internal systems like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, and more via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Gemini now has over 1 billion monthly active users, with nearly 90% of Fortune 100 companies using Gemini Enterprise, and Google will initially roll out the agent to businesses before consumers to address security and scale challenges. The agent operates with its own Workspace account, provides a "tasks inbox" for tracking progress and audit trails, supports multi-model orchestration including third-party models like Anthropic's Claude, and offers flexible spending controls with real-time spend caps.

items.title: Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 活跃用户达 4000 万新高，付费账户重置已全部到账
items.summary: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 合计活跃用户数创 4000 万新高，GPT-6 已正式上线 Chat 功能。所有付费账户的银行重置（banked reset）已全部到账。
